note: CAPTURED, never edited by hand: zakholdsworth/chaotic-pendulums-co's docs/case-study.json, which the pendulum's own build counts from the things themselves. .github/workflows/case-study.yml reads it at the pendulum's main once a day and, when the counts move, writes this file again and opens a pull request. `captured` says where it was read, at which commit and on which day; `counts` is the file as it was read. The case study's numbers are read from here, never typed.
